episodes.title: Stay Inside
episodes.summary: A deadly virus spread by rainfall forces siblings Simone and Rasmus to seek refuge in an underground bunker, parting ways with their scientist father.

episodes.title: Stay Together
episodes.summary: After six years of isolation, Simone and Rasmus encounter other survivors. To stay alive, Simone must prove herself useful to the group.

episodes.title: Avoid the City
episodes.summary: Simone and the others set out for Apollon headquarters in Sweden, but their trek through Copenhagen is fraught with peril.

episodes.title: Trust No One
episodes.summary: Jealousy flares in Martin and Beatrice. Simone and Rasmus meet a doctor with a connection to their father. A memory haunts Jean.

episodes.title: Have Faith
episodes.summary: Lost in the woods, the group stumbles upon a mansion. The residents invite them to stay the night, and Lea bonds with one of the women.

episodes.title: Keep Your Friends Close
episodes.summary: Rasmus and Beatrice grow closer as they spend time alone together. The others discover a new bunker -- and a disturbing secret that lies within.

episodes.title: Don't Talk to Strangers
episodes.summary: A band of armed strangers tries to extract information from Patrick. Rasmus begins to unravel in the wake of a grim discovery.

episodes.title: Trust Your Instincts
episodes.summary: The group arrives at Apollon headquarters, where Simone learns startling truths about the virus, her father and Rasmus.

episodes.title: Avoid Contact
episodes.summary: On the run from Apollon soldiers, the group follows a set of coordinates to a base where rebel scientists are working on a vaccine for the virus.

episodes.title: The Truth Hurts
episodes.summary: Martin accompanies Simone on a journey to retrieve her father's computer. At the base, Patrick stumbles upon a hidden room filled with strange devices.

episodes.title: Stay in Control
episodes.summary: As Apollon surrounds the base, Simone scrambles to find a cure. Rasmus's secret draws Sarah to him -- but threatens to tear the group apart.

episodes.title: Save Yourself
episodes.summary: Simone, Martin and Fie pursue Rasmus and Sarah, whose bond deepens while they're on the run. Patrick makes another discovery. Jean tries to console Lea.

episodes.title: Keep It Together
episodes.summary: Plagued by frightening visions, Rasmus takes his fate into his own hands. Sarah's health worsens. Jean and Lea share a tender moment.

episodes.title: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.summary: In the wake of their grim encounter, Martin and Patrick race back to the base. Meanwhile, a grief-stricken survivor plots revenge.

episodes.title: Don't Give Up
episodes.summary: Haunted by nightmares and afraid of his newfound powers, Rasmus voluntarily confines himself at Apollon. Meanwhile, Simone ventures beyond the wall.

episodes.title: Never Let Go
episodes.summary: Simone meets a brother and sister living off the grid. Back at Apollon, Patrick and Fie weigh their options, and Rasmus makes a horrifying discovery.

episodes.title: Stay Strong
episodes.summary: Simone refuses to leave unless Daniel gives her the flower extract. Sten wants to test Fie's theory and threatens Rasmus to ensure his cooperation.

episodes.title: Be the Change You Want in the World
episodes.summary: Simone's group approaches a camp of young survivors. Rasmus's thirst for power spirals out of control, and Martin leaves Apollon to search for Simone.

episodes.title: Love Yourself
episodes.summary: As Rasmus grows weaker, a worried Sarah asks Fie for help. Reunited, Martin and Simone begin the long trek back to Apollon.

episodes.title: And This Too Shall Pass
episodes.summary: A surprising revelation sparks new hope — but Simone and the others must ready themselves for a dangerous confrontation as Rasmus closes in.
